_readme: Maps channel names in exported logs (GAP IIDTool live-data CSV, or other CSV tools) to lr3diag channels. Values must end up metric (°C, km/h, mm), so use scale/offset to convert. Names CONFIRMED from a real IIDControl 4.3 export are listed first; the rest are PLACEHOLDERS, so correct them once you have a log that includes those values. Matching ignores case, spaces and punctuation. Copy this file to ~/.lr3diag/gap_mapping.json to customise it.

Vehicle speed._note: GAP exported mph on this phone; set scale to 1.0 if your app is set to km/h
